content: <thought>Using the mass spectrum we identified a monoisotopic peak at m/z 183.045 with a characteristic M+2 peak (~32 % intensity) at m/z 185.042, indicating the presence of a single chlorine atom. Subtracting the chlorine mass (34.968852) gives a neutral mass of ~148.076 Da, which corresponds well to the formula C₉H₈ClO₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 183.021 Da). This formula fits the observed isotopic pattern and the small M+1 peak (~10 %) from ¹³C. To obtain possible structures matching this formula, we request isomers from the database.
